summary: Tessa: (1) a fyi inbox status for mail she was only copied on; (2) every Tessa table (the seven existing ones plus the new ea_followup_events) revokes all privileges from anon and authenticated and enables row level security with no policies, so only the server secret key (which bypasses RLS) can read Ed's private correspondence; (3) delegated follow-through: ea_inbox keeps conversation_id and attachment NAMES, ea_followups gains kind (task|signed_return), community_id, source_inbox_id and a steps checklist, and ea_followup_events is the append-only audit of each step. Changes no existing value.

preflight.name: the ea_inbox status CHECK is named ea_inbox_status_check and allows exactly the three current values
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.ea_inbox'::regclass AND contype = 'c' AND conname = 'ea_inbox_status_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%needs_review%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%replied%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%dismissed%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) NOT LIKE '%fyi%'

preflight.name: no other CHECK on ea_inbox mentions status (so the replacement is the only status rule)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.ea_inbox'::regclass AND contype = 'c' AND conname <> 'ea_inbox_status_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%status%'

preflight.name: all seven Tessa tables exist
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('ea_inbox','ea_followups','ea_contacts','ea_standing_tasks','tessa_outbox','ea_email_events','ea_contact_email_history')

preflight.name: ea_followup_events does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ea_followup_events'

preflight.name: ea_followups has no kind column yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ea_followups' AND column_name IN ('kind','community_id','source_inbox_id','steps')

expected_changes: ea_inbox_status_check is replaced: status IN ('needs_review','replied','dismissed','fyi'). Every existing row still satisfies it.
ea_inbox gains conversation_id (text) and attachment_names (jsonb); both NULL on existing rows.

ea_followups gains kind (NOT NULL DEFAULT task, CHECK task|signed_return), community_id (FK communities, RESTRICT), source_inbox_id (FK ea_inbox, SET NULL) and steps (jsonb); every existing follow-up reads kind task.
New table ea_followup_events (append-only audit: followup_id FK RESTRICT, event CHECK, actor, detail, created_at); service_role SELECT, INSERT only.
REVOKE ALL on the seven Tessa tables FROM anon, authenticated (four of them granted SELECT to authenticated).
ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (no policies) on the seven Tessa tables. The server's secret key bypasses RLS, so every /api/tessa route behaves exactly as before.
service_role keeps SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all seven.
No row changes. Paul Grover's 2026-10-19 'RE: Tax return' row stays status 'dismissed'; the app shows it as Copied (FYI) by rule.

verify.name: the status CHECK allows fyi
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.ea_inbox'::regclass AND conname = 'ea_inbox_status_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%fyi%'

verify.name: row level security is on for all eight Tessa tables
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relrowsecurity AND c.relname IN ('ea_inbox','ea_followups','ea_contacts','ea_standing_tasks','tessa_outbox','ea_email_events','ea_contact_email_history','ea_followup_events')

verify.name: no Tessa table has a policy (nobody but the server reads it)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename IN ('ea_inbox','ea_followups','ea_contacts','ea_standing_tasks','tessa_outbox','ea_email_events','ea_contact_email_history','ea_followup_events')

verify.name: signed-in users (authenticated) and anon hold no privilege on any Tessa table
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND grantee IN ('anon','authenticated') AND table_name IN ('ea_inbox','ea_followups','ea_contacts','ea_standing_tasks','tessa_outbox','ea_email_events','ea_contact_email_history','ea_followup_events')

verify.name: the server role can still read and write all seven
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND grantee = 'service_role' AND privilege_type IN ('SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE') AND table_name IN ('ea_inbox','ea_followups','ea_contacts','ea_standing_tasks','tessa_outbox','ea_email_events','ea_contact_email_history')

verify.name: every existing follow-up is kind task
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM ea_followups WHERE kind <> 'task'

verify.name: the audit table is insert-only for the server (no UPDATE or DELETE grant)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ea_followup_events' AND grantee = 'service_role' AND privilege_type IN ('UPDATE','DELETE')
